Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)
Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.6)

Required findings: Candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3: Repeat Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy or Laminectomy) at the Same Level

Imaging evidence of anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) demonstrating dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of supine and upright images showing a translational alignment difference between vertebrae >3mm
Imaging evidence of Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the requested level(s)

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and/or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery
Objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and laboratory to validate 6-week abstinence if not a never-smoker
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.5)

Non-Indications: Absence of anterolisthesis with dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translational difference on flexion-extension or supine/upright imaging) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis for first recurrent disc herniation
Failure to qualify as a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3
Current use of nicotine, smoking, or smokeless tobacco products within six (6) weeks prior to surgery without validated objective cotinine testing confirming abstinence
Inability to provide objective cotinine testing results (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal laboratory reference ranges to verify 6-week nicotine abstinence
Important criteria & exceptions: For second or greater recurrent disc herniation, specific imaging findings of instability or spondylolisthesis are not required; only candidate status for repeat discectomy and nicotine-free documentation are needed
Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal lab ranges if the patient is not a never-smoker
Procedure requires concurrent qualification for lumbar decompression or corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression as a foundational criterion
Documentation required: Flexion-extension plain x-rays or supine and upright comparison imaging reports
Advanced imaging reports (MRI/CT) confirming recurrent disc herniation and anterolisthesis/spondylolisthesis grade
Prior operative reports documenting previous lumbar discectomy
Objective cotinine test results (serum, urinary, or saliva) with corresponding laboratory reference ranges
Provider clinical notes documenting smoking history, nicotine abstinence duration, and functional impairment
